reviews.message: Potential unsafe checkout of untrusted pull request on non-privileged workflow.
reviews.reason: This checkout is reached only through workflow_dispatch. A maintainer with repository write access explicitly selects the ref and either this repository or signalapp/Signal-Android; no pull_request or pull_request_target event supplies the ref. The medium-precision query classifies the input name ref as a pull-request head even for this dispatch-only workflow. The job runs on a fresh GitHub-hosted runner with contents: read, persist-credentials: false and server-enforced cache-mode: read; BuildKit cache export is disabled. The selected source is still trusted code: nightly builds receive NIGHTLY_URL. Dispatchers must review the selected source before running it. This review concerns the reported untrusted-pull-request checkout and does not assert that arbitrary selected code is safe.
